description: This Java class, VcapServicesStringSupplier, provides functionality to read configuration data from a file specified either via an environment variable or directly through a static factory method. It encapsulates file reading logic, error handling for invalid paths or unreadable files, and returns an Optional<String> containing the file content.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringSupplier
classes.description: Immutable supplier class that reads VCAP service configuration data from a file at a specified path or environment variable.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a VcapServicesStringSupplier instance based on the environment variable VCAP_LOCATION.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a VcapServicesStringSupplier instance for a given file path.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the file content as an Optional<String>, reading the config file if present.

methods.name: tryToReadConfigFile
methods.description: Attempts to read the configuration file and handles IOExceptions by logging and throwing a DittoConfigError.

methods.name: readConfigFile
methods.description: Reads all bytes from the file and returns the content as a String if not empty; otherwise returns null.
